qualification:
Unseeded native stage1 entry derives canonical data slots at verifier entry.
The actual SDK body and all full Rc/borrow/metadata input domains are retained.
A common successful verifier child returns an empty Vec, so checkpoint write is
unreachable and no accepted-result or independently canonical-slot premise is used.
domain: All unseeded proof/public/checkpoint bytes58295/1880/1768, independent arbitrary data/lamport slot maps0..2, all metadata, every signed borrow counter and nonzero usize Rc header. Actual unchanged source reaching its first_decoded/verifier child must derive data_slots=[0,1,2]; every returned path preserves the prior scalar/Rc postconditions. Common successful typed pure children remain explicit and exact first-call pointer/public/k/None assertions remain. The verifier returns a successful empty Vec; source length rejection must prevent every destination-copy invocation.
retained: Fixed rooted buffer lengths and concrete heap-construction domain; actual pure child instances, general runtime embedding, earlier source-prefix/scan transport and ordered state/log/oracle correspondence. This is source entry normalization, not a whole successful stage1 or S2 closure.
entry_cut: Only688-byte memcmp calls are marked and forced to return nonzero; all other lengths forward to the original libc model. The caller asserts canonical slots at the comparison entry, before any returned byte-comparison result is needed. The marker uses a no_mangle usize static with a nonzero initializer and is reset in the harness; no native source buffer/SDK behavior before the cut changes. Full first/observer/writeback correctness is not claimed from this entry cut.
